Name: Shapely Shiko
Author: bezajel
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47872/47872-1781920969-1087974131.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=5]Alternative sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url][/size][/center]


[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Seasonal or non-seasonal outfits as set in the config of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Choice of colour scheme: [/color]
[b]Original[/b] uses low-chroma black; [b]Stardew[/b] uses saturated chromatic blacks; [b]Purple[/b] uses chromatic blacks and gives her purple hair.[/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]'No Nose' option provided to match Seasonal Cute style[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Show or hide choker accessory from sprite[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Optional sleep sprite - adds a sleeping animation to her schedule so she doesn't lie awake all night[/color][/*]
[/list]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip and place in your Mods folder. [/color][color=#d4d4d8]Requires Content Patcher and [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url] v1.6 or later.
[color=#d4d4d8]Options can be configured in GMCM.[/color]



[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Papaya for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]the OG Shiko mod[/url] for making a great character with timeless style.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to silvermoonchan for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]reviving Shiko[/url], giving me permission to create these sprites, and allowing me to tinker with the original mod.[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]And a hat tip to the various Busty Zuzu City Girl portraits, which inspired me to create a shapely style of sprite.[/size][/color]
